findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A31–A32 identify commercial pooled serum, triplicate per concentration and mean ± SD. A40 labels the additional summary row Mean without specifying its calculation.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed replicate and pooling definitions and the definition of the method-specific Mean row before interpreting experimental independence or preparing that summary for analysis. Preserve the reported values without reconstructing individuals.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T3:A29–A32 establish rat serum binding of polymyxin B1 only, explicitly excluding ELF and tissue binding. The page does not establish applicability to other PMB analytes, formulations or matrices, or provide a physiological bridge.
findings.needed_material: Record the intended analyte and matrix use and review supporting evidence for any proposed extension or conversion. Retain this input as polymyxin B1 rat serum binding until compatibility is established.
